raw_payload.source_title: MCM/ICM Contest Rules, Registration and Instructions, January 28 - February 1, 2027
raw_payload.edition_text: COMAP's 2027 instructions identify Mathematical Contest in Modeling (MCM) and Interdisciplinary Contest in Modeling (ICM). 2027 contest dates are January 28 through February 1.
raw_payload.eligibility_text: The contest is open to undergraduate and high school students. Team members must be enrolled full- or part-time at the same school or institution at the time of the contest.
raw_payload.team_text: Each team may consist of one, two, or three students enrolled at the same school or institution. Each student may participate on only one team. An advisor registers the team; a school may register multiple teams.
raw_payload.registration_text: Registration deadline is before 3:00 p.m. EST on Thursday, January 28, 2027.
raw_payload.schedule_text: Contest starts 5:00 p.m. EST Thursday, January 28, 2027 and ends 8:00 p.m. EST Monday, February 1, 2027. The solution report deadline is 9:00 p.m. EST Monday, February 1, 2027; results are scheduled for May 8, 2027.
raw_payload.problem_text: MCM problem choices are Problem A, Problem B and Problem C. Problem D, Problem E and Problem F belong to ICM.
raw_payload.timezone_interpretation_text: 官方日程明确写 EST。Etc/GMT+5 是表示 UTC−05:00 的 IANA 固定偏移时区，名称中的符号遵循反向的 POSIX 惯例；它记录来源明示的 EST 偏移量，不声称来源使用了 America/New_York 等地理时区名称。
raw_payload.semantic_note: 本 Fixture 只表示 MCM；共享规则中还出现 ICM，但它是另一赛事。官方资格也包括高中生，不能缩窄为仅限大学生。来源未给出报名开始的具体时刻。Problem A/B/C 是 MCM 的赛题选择，Problem D/E/F 属于 ICM；赛题不作为 CompetitionTrack。论文提交截止和结果公布日期均不作为 competition_end。
